limitations: Representative community origins, not individual home routes

licences: City of Calgary Open Data terms

classification.features: facility name only; published type, source_class, geography and IDs excluded

Name-based service classification does not establish quality, availability or eligibility
Shared brand wording may remain across different normalized name groups
